The '''Adumari Planetary Defense Forces''' was formed in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Adumar]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Teren Rogriss]], who relinquished his command of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Agonizer (starship)|''Agonizer'']], was appointed Defense Minister by [[Balass ke Teldan]], the new [[perator]] of [[Cartann]]. It carries the rank of [[General/Legends|General]] in the defense force.<ref name="adumar" />
